changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwbillingpricingsnapshot AS SELECT bps.id, bps.charge_line_id, bps.patient_service_product_id, bps.patient_id, bps.encounter_id, bps.price_list_id, bps.price_list_item_id, bps.billing_configuration_id, bps.discount_id, bps.tax_id, bps.pricing_source, bps.pricing_version, bps.price_list_code, bps.price_list_name, bps.price_list_item_code, bps.quantity, bps.base_unit_price, bps.gross_amount, bps.discount_type, bps.discount_rate, bps.discount_amount, bps.discount_reason, bps.discount_approved_by, bps.exemption_type, bps.exemption_rate, bps.exemption_amount, bps.exemption_reason, bps.tax_type, bps.tax_rate, bps.taxable_amount, bps.tax_amount, bps.net_amount, bps.currency, bps.calculation_order, bps.rounding_mode, bps.rounding_scale, bps.patient_responsibility_amount, bps.insurance_responsibility_amount, bps.other_payer_responsibility_amount, bps.calculation_payload, bps.status, bps.effective_date, bps.superseded_date, bps.superseded_by_snapshot_id, bps.pricing_reason, bps.override_reason, bps.idempotency_key, bps.created_by, bps.created_date, bps.price_source, bps.setup_source_id, bps.last_modified_by, bps.last_modified_date FROM public.billing_pricing_snapshot bps;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwbillingpricingsnapshot TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwbillingpricingsnapshot FROM report_user;
